implementation: Quoted char/i64/u64/duration/instant use the existing complete string frame. Char requires exactly one decoded UTF-16 unit; surrogate units remain values while a surrogate pair is two units. Integer codecs parse an exact interior byte slice with whole-consumption and range checks, preserving rejection of plus, leading zero, negative zero and overflow. Complete frame validity independently owns canonical JSON, quotes, original bounds and delimiter existence. Colon is rejected for all semantic value parsers. Duration/instant use the frozen signed-64 encoding. No aggregate scan or extra collection pipeline is introduced.
